concepts.label: Sync Gateway 4.1.0
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused within batch - the Debian 11.x (Bullseye) deprecation is dated to this release

relations.subject: sgw:sync-gateway-instance
relations.evidence: Sync Gateway clusters on mixed platforms are not supported. Nodes in a Sync Gateway cluster should all be running on the same OS, and every effort should be made to apply the same OS patches across the entire cluster.

notable_absence.finding: No predicate in the registry captures a plain 'runs on operating system X' fact (as against a version-gated capability requirement) - Tables 1-3 are a large matrix of Sync-Gateway-to-OS/cloud-platform support (RHEL, Alma, Rocky, Ubuntu, Debian, Windows Server, AWS/Azure/Google Cloud, macOS, Windows Desktop) that this extraction did not turn into a relation per cell, since minting a concept per OS/cloud-platform-version combination (dozens of rows) would be exactly the 'a canonical reference table mints its rows at recurrence 1 by construction' pattern flagged in this round's hypothesis, with no existing OS/platform vocabulary in the registry to anchor against. Recorded here as prose rather than as dozens of low-value minted concepts.
